scope: controlled development, not confirmatory ablation or submission method
shared_changes: Same checkpoint, input packing, map, background policy and initial states
Footprint-based recovery margin instead of centerline-offset cutoffs
No braking solely because an aligned 4.4-unit offset exceeds 0.42 normalized lateral
Same pool: actor, old rule anchor and lane/speed templates; actual deduplicated count recorded
No use of joint-clearance teacher's candidate veto, planned future or selected action
Batched deterministic mean rollout; validated against scalar scoring

score_comparison.physical: Projected progress and explicit local footprint, contact proximity, heading penalties; old reward/risk/uncertainty heads not used for ranking

limitations: Bundle-level score change, not isolated attribution to a single risk or reward term
Risk head was trained on old proxy labels; geometric-score variant does not silently claim it was retrained
Geometric footprints use local rectangular approximations, not physical collision probabilities
A single shared map seed is exploratory only; stop and diagnose poor performance without selecting favorable cases
